texts.zh: 来自[pickup_planet.GetName]的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。我们规划了一系列活动，包括方舟舰参观和关于我们生活方式的宣讲，以便让他们在前往[dropoff_planet.GetName]的旅途中过得愉快。
texts.en: The diplomatic delegation from [pickup_planet.GetName] has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. We have planned a schedule of activities including arkship tours and presentations on our lifestyle to keep them entertained during the journey to [dropoff_planet.GetName].

texts.zh: 来自[pickup_planet.GetName]的外交使团已经登上了方舟舰，并正以符合[pickup_planet.owner.GetName]大使身份的礼遇规格受到接待。他们为我们提供了有关[dropoff_planet.owner.GetName]的外交情报，我们利用这些情报建立了正式联系。
texts.en: The diplomatic delegation from [pickup_planet.GetName] has boarded the arkship and are being accommodated with all the respect due to ambassadors from the [pickup_planet.owner.GetName]. They brought us diplomatic intelligence regarding the [dropoff_planet.owner.GetName] that we used to establish formal communications.

label.zh: 让我们平安地将他们送达目的地。
label.en: Let us bring them safely to their destination.

title.zh: 前往合约地点（外交支持）
